mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ec_rule WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM employeeec WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oplog WHERE requestKey=#{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ec_rule SET name=#{name},type=#{type},amount=#{amount},description=#{description}, enabled=#{enabled},version=version+1,updatedAt=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE employeeec SET status='CANCELLED',cancelledBy=#{cancelledBy},cancelledByName=#{cancelledByName}, cancelledAt=#{cancelledAt},cancelReason=#{cancelReason} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ec_rule ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

where.if: AND (COALESCE(r.employeeName,e.name) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR COALESCE(r.workId,e.workID) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.eid,r.ecDate,r.ecReason,r.ecPoint,r.ecType,r.remark,r.ruleId,r.ruleVersion,r.ruleName,r.ruleDescription, r.amount,r.defaultAmount,COALESCE(r.employeeName,e.name) AS employeeName,COALESCE(r.workId,e.workID) AS workId, r.departmentName,r.status,r.operatorId,r.operatorName,r.createdAt,r.cancelledBy,r.cancelledByName,r.cancelledAt,r.cancelReason FROM employeeec r LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id=r.eid ORDER BY r.ecDate DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employeeec r LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id=r.eid
